messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the RFC review — we need a compact plan for 'variant routing' across hosted / dedicated / private so SDKs and infra can depend on a stable surface. My thinking: an explicit, small capability contract + a runtime probe endpoint. Thoughts?

maria: +1. We keep the control-plane contract minimal: what variants are available, per-variant QoS (latency SLO tiers), and compatibility tags (quantized, kv-cache-safe, tokenizer).

jevon: Important callout: 'compatibility tags' can't be too fine-grained or we'll end up with N x M combinatorics. Suggest a two-level approach: stable platform capabilities (kernel/quantization families) and optional detailed hints (perf numbers, supported seq lengths).

pat: Also need to encode cost hints. Routing decisions for Dedicated customers will depend on price buckets and latency buckets. Cost should be advisory, not authoritative.

alex: Right. Proposal sketch for the probe: GET /_internal/variant-capabilities -> returns small json with fields: `variant_id`, `capabilities: ["int8", "kv-cache", "fast-attn"]`, `latency_ms_p50`, `latency_ms_p95`, `token_limit`, `compat_tags: ["hf-tokenizer-v2"]`. SDKs use this + policy rules to pick target.

maria: Example policy primitives: prefer_same_model_family, prefer_low_cost_under_Xms, fallback_to_compatible_variants. Keep policy DSL tiny.

jevon: We'll need server-side validation: control plane should reject rollouts that advertise capabilities not present on the runtime. Otherwise hosted could advertise something private can't satisfy. Either an admission check or an e2e probe during rollout.

pat: For Private deployments, runtime probe must be optional (air-gapped installs). We need a local agent that syncs control-plane intent and verifies capabilities on a schedule. That agent can upload only metadata when allowed.

alex: Good point. So three modes: Hosted (control plane queries probes directly), Dedicated (control plane + scheduled probes, tenant-limited), Private (agent-run probes, outbound optional). We'll standardize the same JSON shape even if some fields are omitted.

maria: We should avoid leaking PII or customer topology in the probe. Strip anything that looks like node identifiers; only aggregate capabilities and perf numbers.

jevon: About API shape: keep top-level keys stable. If we need extension, allow `extensions` map with short URIs so we can evolve without breaking older SDKs. e.g.: `extensions{"/ext/quant-prof": "v1"}`.

pat: Observability: report which policy decision picked which variant and why (cost vs latency). Console needs token-level cost delta estimates for the chosen variant to show tradeoffs. This ties into Optimize later.

alex: Backwards compatibility: older SDKs that expect `variant` field should still work. Plan: initial v1 surface has `variants: []` with the minimal schema. Add a compatibility header `X-Variant-Proto: v1`.

maria: Rollout plan: (1) implement probe + schema validator in runtime (2) implement agent for private installs (3) small SDK change to prefer variants by policy (4) opt-in experiments for a few customers. Keep feature behind flags.

jevon: Implementation note: keep the probe lightweight and O(1) for a single call. No heavy benchmarks during probe. Use cached perf numbers from runtime telemetry sampled by the node, not live microbenchmarks.

pat: Tests: unit tests for schema, integration test that simulates mismatch (control plane says int8 but runtime reports none) and fails rollout. Also e2e that shows policy pick and fallback.

deploy-bot: CI: variant-contracts/runtimescope checks passed in staging -> https://ci.redwood/jobs/variant-contracts/1234

alex: Next actions: I can draft a tiny RFC patch with the probe schema + examples. Jevon, can you add admission check pseudo-code? Pat, can you draft the console events we need to emit? Maria, agent responsibilities for private go to you?

maria: Assigned. I'll sketch the agent lifecycle and limited telemetry upload rules.

jevon: Will add admission pseudo and a small compatibility matrix.

pat: I'll list the console events and sample UI strings. Also will add the cost/hint semantics.

sre-bot: Note: rolling test cluster deploy for probe endpoint scheduled at 03:15 UTC.

alex: Great. I'll open the RFC PR later today with schema + migration notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
